reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes Al2O3 will form on an Al-free alloy; fluorine treatment alone cannot create aluminum where none exists, making the proposed mechanism physically unsound.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clearly described with specific conditions, measurements, and a falsification criterion, but it tests an impossible mechanism, so the test would not meaningfully decide the intended question.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it relies on a fundamental compositional error (no Al in the alloy), so it cannot guide practical research on HfNbTaTiZr.
